title: 月食の夜に、あまーい秘密を添えて
author: 春宮こより

en.title: A Sweet Secret on the Night of the Lunar Eclipse
en.premise: Seto-kun is the school's 'Ice Prince'—cool, distant, and completely unapproachable. But I've just stumbled upon his shocking secret: he's actually a massive sweets addict! In exchange for my silence, we begin a series of 'Ultimate Sweets Tours' together. Between the sugary treats and our constant bickering, my heart is starting to melt...

zh.title: 月食之夜，附上甜蜜的秘密
zh.premise: 被誉为学校里最冷酷、最难以接近的“冰之王子”的濑户君。然而，我竟然目击到了他一个惊人的秘密——他其实是个超级甜点控！为了换取我对秘密的守口如瓶，我开始和他一起开启“究极甜点巡礼”。在甜蜜的甜点与吵闹的争执之间，不知不觉中，我的心也开始融化了……？
